verdict.rationale: Spline offers an official Code API for web plus code export to Vanilla JS, Three.js, React, Next.js and react-three-fiber, and a Real-time API/webhooks system for programmatic integration — enough for an AI-native developer to build against official interfaces. However these are export/runtime APIs rather than a full SDK suite (no dedicated npm SDK package, no mobile/iOS/Android SDK, no OpenAPI spec — probe found 404s), and there's no independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage. Missing for 10: dedicated versioned SDK packages (e.g. npm/PyPI), multi-platform (mobile/native) SDKs, published OpenAPI/reference docs, and independent developer corroboration.
